qa_pairs.question: What section of the service manual covers headlight cleaners torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: 61 67 Headlight Cleaners under General Electrical system

qa_pairs.question: What are the two connection points specified for headlight cleaner torque values?
qa_pairs.answer: Telescope to bracket (1AZ) and Bracket to body (2AZ)

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque values between the telescope to bracket and bracket to body connections?
qa_pairs.answer: 12 Nm (15 Nm for bracket to body minus 3 Nm for telescope to bracket)

qa_pairs.question: Which headlight cleaner connection requires the higher torque value?
qa_pairs.answer: The bracket to body connection (2AZ) requires 15 Nm, which is higher than the 3 Nm for telescope to bracket (1AZ)

qa_pairs.question: Are the screw types the same for both headlight cleaner mounting points?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both the telescope to bracket and bracket to body connections use E36 type screws
